title: Dota2 Senate
description: Senators in a round-robin process ban each other to secure victory for their party.
pseudocode:
1. queueR = [indices of R]; queueD = [indices of D]
2. while (queueR and queueD):
3.   r = queueR.shift(); d = queueD.shift()
4.   if r < d: queueR.push(r + n)
5.   else: queueD.push(d + n)
6. return queueR ? "Radiant" : "Dire"

steps.note: Initialize queues with indices. Input: 'RD', n=2.
Pop R index 0 and D index 1.
0 < 1, so R wins this round and gets pushed to the back.
